strategy.name: ICT Silver Bullet & Power of 3
strategy.summary: Trade only inside three one-hour New York windows: after a sweep, a structure shift and FVG toward the nearest liquidity target.

rules.text: Enter only inside 03:00–04:00, 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00 New York time — never before the window opens.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the entry inside a Silver Bullet window?

rules.text: Identify the nearest unswept 15m/1H liquidity pool as the target.
rules.checklistQuestion: Did you mark the draw on liquidity first?

rules.text: Inside the window: sweep of a short-term high/low, then a 1m/5m MSS + FVG toward the target → limit at the start of the FVG.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was there a sweep, MSS, and FVG inside the window?

rules.text: Stop at the displacement swing high/low + 2 ticks.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the stop beyond the displacement swing?

rules.text: Minimum target: 15–20 handles NQ, 50 points US30, 15–20 pips EURUSD/GBPUSD, or 1:2–1:3.
rules.checklistQuestion: Did the target meet the minimum?

rules.text: If high-impact news is at 10:00, wait until 10:15 and trade only 10:15–11:00.
rules.checklistQuestion: On a 10:00 news day, did you wait until 10:15?
